title: CLO 2025.1 New Features Highlight Video - A Quick Overview of the Intelligence and Strength of the New Version!
description:
The smarter and more powerful CLO 2025.1 new version is officially launched! In this version, we have developed new features based on user feedback to make your garment production workflow more efficient!

The new version will bring the following core features: CLO AI Studio, denim washing effect presets, seamless partitioning, upgraded 3D pen, CLO zFab fabric measurement kit x CLOFAB, a zipper tab added to the object window, and a seamless experience with CLO-SET and CONNECT.

Experience the power of the new features online with CLO technical experts and redefine your imagination!

summary: # CLO 2025.1 New Features Highlight Video Welcome to the CLO 2025.1 New Features Highlight Video! In this video, we will introduce you to the exciting new functionalities available in the latest version of KOLO. Let’s dive into the main features. ## Main Functionality Overview ### 3D Pen Virtual Model Tool - Use our **3D pen virtual model tool** to directly draw on the model. - Even if you don't have prior experience, you can freely express your creativity in KOLO. - This update enhances the tool, allowing you to: - Draw not only on the virtual model but also in three-dimensional space using shortcut keys. - All common shortcuts remain functional. ### Quick Costume Creation - Add a circle around the virtual model to show the distance from your drawing point to the model. - Quickly draw a costume in KOLO using the flat panel tool, which converts your lines into paper. - The system automatically arranges and sews the panel for you. - Finally, add fabric to complete your clothing design. ## Material Types and Water-Washing Options ### New Material Type - To enhance the performance of denim, we have added a **material type of single-seam cloth**. - Introducing **eight types of water-washing presets**: - Water washing - Drying washing - Speed washing - Slipper washing - Acid washing - Sterilizing - Smell Yang washing - Custom-assigned options for user adjustment and testing in KOLO. ### Water-Washing Customization - Each water-washing model provides different slide options based on the chosen method. - Adjust cycle time and phonical module options; longer times result in lighter colors. - Utilize the custom option to upload your own water wash effect picture and adjust details quickly. ## Seamless Clothing Design ### Seamless Division Tool - The seamless division tool helps designers create seamless clothing without cutting or sewing. - Use the hook and loop tool to link inner lines or basic lines into seamless division lines. - Apply different fabrics post-division in a straightforward manner. - The tool also allows for adjustments to the lines created and the textures of each seamless division. ### Software Model Simulation - Simulate the software model using OBJ files for items like pillows or sponges. - The virtual model’s shape will adjust according to fabric differences. - This functionality also applies to clothing accessories such as shoulder pads. ### Enhanced Simulation Features - The seamless division tool now offers improved selection and display effects for better process application. - Adjust the virtual model's ratio and edit its details, including length, width, and thickness. ## Library and AI Enhancements ### Updated Library Features - The library now includes an independent **CONNECT** label for checking purchase records and high-quality resources. - Improved layout for easier navigation and project searching. ### AI Functions - All AI functions are conveniently accessible via the AI button next to the library. - Example: Use the AI rendering amplifier to upload a rendering image and generate different AI faces. - Background options and image optimization features are also included for enhanced realism. ## Project Management and Fabric Features ### Project File Management - Save selected versions and components as one costume, simplifying project file extraction. - Added a zipper option card for quick application and editing. ### Fabric Generation - The integration of the fabric generator and seamless fabric generator into **CloFab** allows for detailed fabric creation. - Input fabric information, attributes, and PBR stickers seamlessly. - Save fabrics as documents for easy application to outfits. ## Quick Photo and DXF Export Features ### Quick Photo Optimization - New functions for self-defined line shapes and colors for easier line editing. - Enhanced usability for quick photo files, suitable for various applications beyond printing. ### DXF Export and Import - Standard DXF file compatibility has been improved, facilitating integration with other CAD software. ## Version Generator and Editing Improvements ### Version Generator Enhancements - Upload any clothing image to generate a version according to the image. - Continue editing to refine the size and design before simulating the wearing effect. ### Editing Features - The editing version now aligns with the page axis, reducing the need for repetitive processing. - Updated cutout settings improve accuracy for users in unified companies. ## Conclusion These are just some of the exciting new features available in the CLO 2025.1 version. For more information and a deeper look at these functionalities, please check our official website and follow our new features introduction video. Thank you for watching! We hope you enjoy the updates in the new version and have fun using these new features in KOLO!
